lines.text: After Ehud died, the LORD sold Israel to Jabin, king of Canaan, who had nine hundred iron chariots.
Deborah summoned Barak, who was commanded to march to Mount Hermon with ten thousand men of Naphtali and Zebulun.
The LORD routed Sisera's army, and Sisera fled on foot to the tent of Jael, wife of Heber the Kenite.
Jael gave Sisera milk and covered him, and while he slept she drove a tent peg through his temple.
Sisera's mother watched from the window for his chariot, and the land had rest for eighty years.
